Description:
Sorry to abandon this project and not being present in the post section. I'm not a modder, just liked the idea and made this for myself, so I figured other people might like it to and shared it here for free.

Here you can find a Content Patcher version made by netish in the official forum of the game:

[url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/migrating-xnb-mods-to-content-patcher-packs.141577/page-101]Sakamoto Replacer Mod[/url]

Thank you for the support this mod had all this time.
Have a great day farmers.
